probes.server:
-- TEMPORARY LOCAL STUDIO OBSERVER
task.spawn(function()
 local H=game:GetService("HttpService")
 local q={events={},started=server.clock.utcNowMs(),count=0};local seen={};local moved=false
 local function emit(e) table.insert(q.events,e);script:SetAttribute("GiftQA",H:JSONEncode(q)) end
 script:SetAttribute("GiftProbeReady",true)
 for i=1,5000 do
  local now=server.clock.utcNowMs()
  for id,session in server.players do
   local p=activePlayerObjects[id]
   if p and p.Character then
    if not moved then p.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,4,-12));moved=true end
    local snap=session.coordinator.snapshots();local profile=snap.working or snap.durable
    for gid,g in profile.rewards.droneSpawns or {} do
     local row=seen[gid]
     if not row then
      q.count+=1;row={n=q.count};seen[gid]=row
      emit({event="spawn",id=gid,n=row.n,at=now,created=g.createdAtMs,landed=g.landedAtMs,expires=g.expiresAtMs,position=g.position,fixed=g.fixedReward,cash=profile.farm.cash})
      if row.n==2 then p.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(g.position.x,4,g.position.z));emit({event="underInAir",id=gid,at=now,claimed=g.claimed}) end
     end
     if row.n==2 and now<g.landedAtMs and not g.claimed then row.airSamples=(row.airSamples or 0)+1 end
     if now>=g.landedAtMs and not row.land then
      row.land=true;emit({event="landWindow",id=gid,at=now,claimed=g.claimed,airUnclaimedSamples=row.airSamples,cash=profile.farm.cash})
     end
     if row.n==3 and now>=g.landedAtMs+1000 and not row.walk then
      row.walk=true;p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):MoveTo(Vector3.new(g.position.x,3,g.position.z));emit({event="walkToGift",id=gid,at=now,claimed=g.claimed})
     end
     if g.claimed and not row.claim then
      row.claim=true;emit({event="claimed",id=gid,at=now,reward=g.reward,cash=profile.farm.cash})
      if row.n==2 then p.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,4,-12)) end
     end
     if now>=g.expiresAtMs and not row.exp then row.exp=true;emit({event="expired",id=gid,at=now,claimed=g.claimed}) end
    end
   end
  end
  task.wait(.05)
 end
 q.complete=true;script:SetAttribute("GiftQA",H:JSONEncode(q))
end)
probes.client:
-- TEMPORARY LOCAL STUDIO OBSERVER
task.spawn(function()
 local H=game:GetService("HttpService");local q={events={}};local seen={}
 local function emit(e) table.insert(q.events,e);script:SetAttribute("GiftQA",H:JSONEncode(q)) end
 script:SetAttribute("GiftProbeReady",true)
 for i=1,7000 do
  local pres=client:getPresentation();local now=DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis;local active={}
  for id,d in pres._activeDrones do
   active[id]=true
   if not seen[id] then
    seen[id]={};local clicks=0;for _,v in d.model:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("ClickDetector") or v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then clicks+=1 end end
    emit({event="visible",id=id,at=now,start=d.startInstantMs,expires=d.expiresAtMs,model=d.model:GetFullName(),clickHandlers=clicks,shootResult=pres:shootDrone(id,true)})
   end
   if d.landed and not seen[id].land then
    seen[id].land=true;local sub=d.model:FindFirstChild("Subtitle",true)
    emit({event="landed",id=id,at=now,landedAt=d.landedAtMs,hasModel=d.model.Parent~=nil,subtitle=sub and sub.Text})
   end
  end
  for id,row in seen do if not active[id] and not row.gone then row.gone=true;emit({event="gone",id=id,at=now}) end end
  task.wait(.03)
 end
 q.complete=true;script:SetAttribute("GiftQA",H:JSONEncode(q))
end)
